errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range of the value axis is 0 to 85.3. 85.3 is the maximum value displayed in the chart, not the end of the axis range. The logical range for percentages is 0 to 100.
The description claims the value axis has intervals of 1, but the chart has no visible axis line with tick marks or intervals; values are labeled directly on the bars.
The description of the legend items omits the category 'Малко по-труден' (A little more difficult), which is represented by the purple bars.

errors.text_span: „Много по-труден“ (оранжев) и „Не може да се прецени“ (светло син)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors to the categories. In the chart, 'Много по-труден' is light blue/teal, and 'Не може да се прецени' is orange. The description swaps these two.

errors.text_span: като например 85,3 за реда „… за българските граждани, отколкото за хората без българско гражданство“.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the value 85.3 to the category '...for Bulgarian citizens, than for people without Bulgarian citizenship'. The chart shows this value belongs to the category '...for women, than for men'.

errors.text_span: най-малката отбелязана стойност е 0, свързана с отговора "Не може да се прецени" при реда „… за жените, отколкото за мъжете“.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value 0 is associated with the answer 'Cannot decide' ('Не може да се прецени'). In the chart, the value 0 for the gender category corresponds to the answer 'Much more difficult' ('Много по-труден').
